component.name: PGPony
component.summary: OpenPGP encryption, signing, and key management

description.p: PGPony is an OpenPGP application for the desktop. It encrypts, decrypts, signs, and verifies files and messages, and manages a keyring of your own keys and your contacts' public keys, in software or on an OpenPGP smart card over PC/SC.

ul.li: Modern OpenPGP (RFC 9580 v6) alongside classic v4 keys
Post-quantum keys: ML-KEM encryption and composite ML-DSA signatures (RFC 9980)
Hardware keys over PC/SC, including on-card key generation and keytocard
An ssh-agent and a git commit-signing shim served from the keyring
Folder encryption, multi-gigabyte streaming with progress, and watch folders
Keyserver, WKD, and VKS lookup, with an optional Tor or SOCKS5 proxy

screenshot.caption: Encrypt and decrypt on one surface
